data.name: ExchangeHeldTooltip
data.value: These Connected Systems do not manage Exchange recipients now, so their changes wait unattempted. They are delivered once each manages Exchange recipients again.
data.comment: Tooltip on the held count.

data.name: ExchangeRetrying
data.comment: Card title: a change that may clear by itself and is being tried again.

data.name: ExchangeRetryingTooltip
data.value: An attempt failed in a way that may clear by itself, such as replication or a server that did not answer. JIM tries again with a growing interval, and parks the change if it is still failing after 24 hours.
data.comment: Tooltip on the Retrying card.

data.name: ExchangeParkedTooltip
data.value: Exchange refused these, JIM lacks the permission to make them, or they kept failing for 24 hours. JIM has stopped trying, so they wait on a person. Deal with the reason Exchange gave, then retry them.
data.comment: Tooltip on the Parked card.

data.name: ExchangeRefused
data.comment: Card title: a change JIM did not ask Exchange to make. Feminine, agreeing with 'modification'.

data.name: ExchangeRefusedTooltip
data.value: JIM did not ask Exchange to make these, because what is declared cannot be made, such as a mailbox on a contact, or is a change of recipient type JIM does not make. Retrying cannot help. Correct what is declared for the account, and the next synchronisation replaces the change.
data.comment: Tooltip on the Refused card.
